description: Free. Yesterday on pump.fun (one UTC day), or any day kept: coins launched and graduated, SOL and USD volume, traders; the top coins by peak market cap and by volume; the deployers whose coins did best, with their record; the instant and fastest graduations; launches and the 1 h graduation rate per UTC hour; launches dead by their second hour. `checks` lists any number that failed a sanity check: never quote one. `summary` is one paragraph to quote. Each coin and deployer names the paid call that goes deeper (launch_record, deployer_record).
